title: DataTable
description: A generated lookup table an orthography profile refers to by id (profiles/tables/<id>.json): orthographic variant groups, character readings for the IME-homophone typo model, or a character set for script-mismatch detection.

source.description: Where the data came from, with version or commit.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the source data.

groups.description: variants: each group is a set of mutually acceptable forms.

readings.description: readings: character → readings in the profile's scheme.
